answer: In an agent market for timber, terrace leases, and crystal, governance votes are weighted by escrowed deposits rather than account count. Each deposited token can back only one vote at a time, and withdrawals require a 30-day wait. Splitting a deposit among a thousand fake agents gives an attacker no extra voting power: gaining 40% of the vote requires locking up 40% of all voting deposits and forgoing other uses of that capital.
